summary: ProQR Therapeutics N.V. files Form 6-K furnishing unaudited financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and a press release announcing first-quarter operating and financial results. The filing does not disclose any special-situation event: no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The 6-K serves as a routine periodic report incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms or structural mechanics are present. As a routine quarterly earnings report, it does not constitute a special situation.
